privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.statement: Your data stays on your device. GreeCheck does not create an account, store your health profile, or keep your scan history.
privacy.attribution: Product data provided by Open Food Facts (ODbL).
privacy.adsBody: GreeCheck is free and ad-funded. By default, ads are contextual and non-personalized. You can enable personalized ads via consent — handled by an external partner, never by internal profiling in GreeCheck.
privacy.noTrackingBody: GreeCheck builds no ad profile and does not track your behavior in the app.
privacy.localHistory: Scan history — stored locally, erasable anytime.
privacy.localFavorites: Favorites — saved on your device only.
privacy.localBasket: Basket & shopping lists — never sent to a server.
privacy.localPrefs: Preferences, goals and allergens — used locally to personalize your GreeScore.
privacy.noHealthServer: No health data is stored server-side: GreeCheck has no user database and no profiles.
privacy.geoBody: Your position is used only on your device, for the duration of a store search. It is never stored or transmitted.
privacy.contributeBody: If a product can't be found, you can add it to the collaborative Open Food Facts database. Contribution happens on their site, under their terms.

methodology.metaDescription: How the GreeScore is calculated: nutrition, processing, additives, labels, data confidence and sources.
methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.intro: The GreeScore is a 0–100 health decision score, computed locally, deterministically and transparently. Every score can be explained.
methodology.scoreBody: The score combines several criteria families, weighted then renormalized over the data actually available:

buckets.nutrition: Nutrition (35%) — Nutri-Score or, failing that, sugars, salt, saturated fat, fiber and protein.
buckets.additives: Additives & risks (15%) — additive severity, palm oil, avoided allergens.
buckets.labels: Positive labels (10%) — organic, fair trade, clean label.
buckets.goal: Fit with your goals (10%) — only when you set criteria.

rules.bio: Organic brings a significant bonus but never turns an ultra-processed, nutritionally poor product into an excellent one.
rules.halal: Halal is a personal compatibility criterion, never a nutritional quality criterion.
rules.missing: Missing data lowers confidence in the score, never the score itself: unknown is not treated as negative.

methodology.confidenceBody: Every result shows a confidence level based on data completeness: Nutri-Score, ingredients and nutrition facts availability. A poorly documented product shows “partial data” rather than a bad score.
methodology.sourcesBody: Product data comes from Open Food Facts, the open collaborative database. GreeCheck never invents product information.
methodology.privacyBody: Everything is computed on your device: no account, no server-side history, no advertising profile.
